name: admin-leads
doc: The shared lead dashboard on accounts' /admin/leads (the owner, 2026-11-08: "make the shared lead dashboard be in the admin dashboard, not in one of the products"). Toran keeps the outreach and talks to Teder about the same store (its src/ops/leadsAdmin.ts, tederLeads.ts); accounts shows one list for both products and one page a lead, and every button is handed to Toran. The other buttons of a lead (they answered, the next step, later, not interested, a customer) are toran-ops' POST /internal/ops/<toran|teder>/<id>/<action>, as on the dashboard. A demo's state is none, building, review (built, waiting for the operator's look), ready (up, its pageUrl set), failed or removed; where is new, ready, sent, talking or closed. Each row says what can be built for it now (build: toran, also again once its page is built; teder, when it has no demo or one that failed or was removed; both, while neither has one and nothing is being built) and which demo the operator chose to make for it on this dashboard (chosen: toran, teder or both, null when none was; the owner, 2026-11-11: "each leads should have a button for generating a demo for teder/toran/both. the message that is suggested being sent to the phone number on whatsapp should be according to that"). What the lead goes on with is chosen whatever is built (build.go: for both, toran and teder, can, whether it can be chosen, and makes, the demos choosing it would make now, empty when it lacks none; POST go-both, go-toran or go-teder keeps the choice as it is said and makes only those; the owner, 2026-11-12: "i dont see a button for going on with teder/toran/both for each lead"). On one lead, send.options puts the chosen one first when it can go, else both when both can. Each of bothText, toranText and tederText is that message when it is due (null when not): the approved template's words when it goes from our number (pitchable), else the text to copy and send by hand, each demo's link in it; copy is the chat or the mail to open it in, with no text in it. ok false is a refusal in Toran's own words (error, in Hebrew), which accounts shows as it is.
